title: Try Again
author: Claude
blurb: Two short levels about getting a second chance. A pit is too deep for Mia to climb out of, and a post at the bottom starts the level over: it is a link from the post's square back to the same scene. In the next level three pits each have a way back built in, a ladder, steps of planks and steps of solid blocks, so nobody needs a post. Signs say how. Play it, then open it in Game-Maker and find the link.

box.back: A small explorer in a purple beanie has two short levels, and pits in the way each time. One pit is too deep to climb out of, so a post at the bottom starts the level over. In the next level every pit has a way back built in: a ladder, steps of planks, steps of solid blocks. A good level never leaves the player stuck. Read the signs, then open the game in Game-Maker and look at the post.
features: Signs in the levels explain each idea
A post that starts the level over is one scene link back to the same scene
A ladder, planks and solid blocks as ways back out of a pit
Made to be copied and taken apart
